Write this for someone who has not seen the diff or the work behind it.
They should know the problem, the approach and how it is done after reading
the first three sections. See "Pull requests" in AGENTS.md.

Small PRs (one commit, obvious change): Problem, Approach and Tested are enough.
Delete these comments and any optional section you leave empty.
-->

## Problem

<!-- What is wrong or missing today, as a user or operator sees it. Name the
config key, command, path or test involved. No function names, no history. -->

## Approach

<!-- What this PR does about it and what changes for the user, before and after. -->

## Implementation

<!-- Optional. How it is done, for reviewers: the functions, files and design
choices that matter. -->

## In this PR

<!-- Required with more than one commit: one line per commit, tests and docs
included. A commit that does not belong to the problem above goes in its own PR. -->

## Tested

<!-- Where it ran (appengine, device and board), what ran and passed, and what
was not tested. Write "nothing known" rather than leaving the second part out. -->

## Review notes

<!-- Optional. Behaviour changes for existing devices, risks, related PRs
